articles.title: POLY MGM MUSEUM Named to Fortune China’s 2026 Best Design List
articles.summary: [ October 2 8 , 2026, Macau] Jointly established by Poly Culture Group Corporation Limited and MGM, the POLY MGM MUSEUM has been named to Fortune China’s 2026 Best Design list, standing as the only project from Macau to be recognized this year. The honor was presented at the Fortune China Best Design 2026 Awards Ceremony held in Chengdu on October 22.
